title: Resume regression pin does not assert steps 5-6 seed green on arrival, though spec and README require it
evidence:
+     the segments for steps 1 and 2 MUST carry .stepper-segment-done
+     (restored-complete glows green immediately) and step 3's MUST NOT
+     (active only).
detail: Spec matrix row 7 and the README arrival read (`[done, done, active, plain, done, done, plain, plain]`) make vacuous-complete steps 5-6 green on resume arrival, but the canonical YAML pin ignores them; reverting vacuous seeding would not fail the scenario.
recommended_fix: Extend the arrival assertion: segments for the vacuous-complete sections (guarantor-without-guarantor, tell_us_more) MUST also carry .stepper-segment-done on resume.

title: Seeding indexes `sectionEls` while leave-recompute indexes `sections[].el` — index alignment never shown in the diff
detail: Both paths key `done` by section index, but the diff never shows `sections` being built from `sectionEls` in the same order. Any drift (filtering, reordering) would seed or re-derive the wrong steps silently.
recommended_fix: Derive both from one array (e.g. pass sections.map(function(s){return s.el;}) to seedDoneStates) or confirm in review that sections is built 1:1 from sectionEls.

title: Spec Code Map lists only two new pure exports; three are exported and tasked
evidence: +- `server/priv/static/form_stepper.js` — the fix surface: `visited` map in `initBrowser` (lines ~"Steps actually visited" block), `show()`, `updateProgress()`; new pure exports `sectionComplete` + `seedDoneStates`.
detail: The Code Map sentence omits `rederiveDone`, yet the spec's own task bullet and the form_stepper.js export block both include it (`rederiveDone: rederiveDone`). Minor self-contradiction in the shipped spec.
recommended_fix: Amend the Code Map line to read: new pure exports `sectionComplete`, `seedDoneStates`, and `rederiveDone`.
